title: Maximum residual closed Earth-CMB route in the authoritative ICRS quadratic phase metric

assumptions.route_class: single-pass closed loops formed by two distinct Earth-forced meridian semicircles

cost_functional: C[gamma] = integral_gamma sqrt(n^T G_phase n) ds

optimization_parameterization.b_theta: b(theta)=cos(theta)e1+sin(theta)e2, with e1,e2 orthonormal and perpendicular to c_hat

closed_lune.equivalent_branch_degeneracy: Each optimized plane has two antipodally related semicircular branches with equal integrated cost.

earth_force_work.required_asymmetry: Fund the high-cost leg while suppressing, reversing, or otherwise changing Earth coupling on the low-cost return.
